limitation: Actual business functions with in-memory object/Firebase fakes; no live provider, network interruption, video decoding, browser termination or production latency proof.
scope: 30 upload transport +30 generation-bound customer status/publication semantic cases

repeats.note: First three integrity runs plus fourth62-check review-copy retest; no added semantic credit.

neighborChecks.note: Includes62 checks in supplemental runner(60 catalog rows+2 neighbors), existing parts, browser pending/delivery, status failure and manifest checks. Two added neighbors are not independent case credits.

storageMode: existing FakeGcsBucket + generation-pinned composition shim and serialized FakeFirestore
providerMode: none; no model, email or live storage dispatch

failureLedger.invariant: Acknowledged customer upload bytes cannot be silently replaced by a duplicate event
failureLedger.rootCause: captureParts.savePart writes the shared part index without a create-only precondition; same-length conflicting duplicate overwrites original and composes a changed video while total size remains unchanged
failureLedger.repair: Create-only part save. A412 retries only identical generation-pinned bytes; changed bytes/current-generation race rejects without overwriting. Actual route returns409 fixed conflict code and original-video next step. Existing support address and job-link fallback covers customers without a retained local recording.
failureLedger.candidateRetest: All3 same-length corruption cases pass; identical duplicate and generation-replacement neighbors pass; persisted bytes retain original SHA256
failureLedger.limitations: Synthetic byte fixtures prove transport integrity failure, not video-perception behavior. Repair does not recover or certify previously overwritten parts. No production records were faulted or migrated.
failureLedger.releaseStatus: Scoped code-tested; independent review/integration checks/merge/deploy owned by coordinator

sourceHashPolicy: HEAD plus exact tested runtime/helper/runner SHA256; uncommitted tested source is identified by sourceHashes.

reviewCorrection.reason: MediaRecorder409 stops retry; an original-video-only suggestion does not help a lost local recording.
reviewCorrection.resolution: Existing support/job-link fallback added; actual route callback regression passed.
